storage: Keep them in the fridge in their punnet, or in a paper bag, not sealed in plastic (trapped moisture makes them slimy). Use within 3–5 days. Do not wash until just before cooking, and do not soak; they soak up water. Sliced and sautéed mushrooms keep 2–3 days in a closed box in the fridge. Raw mushrooms do not freeze well; freeze only after cooking.

usedIn.raw: 200 g (1 standard pack, about 14–18 medium mushrooms)
